hosts.description: List of host configurations to generate sections for. Each item is an object with the following fields: hostid (string), hostname (string), loginname (string), password (string), srcdir (string), destdir (string), asciifile (list of string), ignorelocaldir (list of string), ignorelocalfile (list of string), ignoreremotedir (list of string), ignoreremotefile (list of string), changetopermissiondir (list of string), changetopermission (string), preservepermissiondir (list of string), usessl (bool), usessslverify (bool), usessslcafile (string), ftppassive (bool), force (bool), chdiratconnection (bool), followsymlinks (bool), logdetaillevel (number), maxretrytosen (number), monochrome (bool), overwriteok (bool), recordlog (bool), renameok (bool), showhiddenfile (bool), silent (bool), convtolower (bool), keeperemotedir (bool), authorizename (string). Only hostid, hostname, loginname, password, srcdir, destdir are strictly required for basic functionality, others use defaults if omitted or if the top-level key is missing from the item.
